_doc: Pip's tool-choice eval (D-779). Each case is one question on one screen and the FIRST model turn it should produce. `expect`: tools the first turn may call; every call it makes must be one of them. `expect_all`: tools that must all be called. `none_ok`: answering in words with no tool is a pass. `forbid`: tools whose call is a named failure (for example set_fields on an action request). `kind` groups the report. `account_open` (admin cases): a client account is open, so the account tools are offered (D-816). Synthetic data only: no real person, number or business. Scored by scripts/copilot_tool_eval.py.
